须在德国境内递交。原句：「须在德国境内、且前置居留（学生居留等）仍然有效时向外管: You must apply from inside Germany. Source sentence: 'you must be in Germany and your prior residence permit must still be valid when you apply'. Leaving on graduation and applying again from abroad does not work.
须已完成学位课程的全部课程要求（论文除外）。本科、硕士、博士均可，每个学历层级各: You must have completed all course requirements for your degree (thesis excepted). Bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees all qualify; each degree level carries 12 months of OPT, and finishing a higher level makes you eligible again. **There is a second, separate duration threshold: you must have been lawfully enrolled on a full-time basis for one full academic year at a SEVP-certified institution (the exact wording used both on the USCIS OPT page and in 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)).** That is not the sum of degrees you hold but the length of time you actually spent enrolled full time at the school. The authority never converts "one full academic year" into a number of months, so min_duration records it in the source's own unit (`{value: 1, unit: academic_years}`); the conversion to months (one academic year = 2 semesters = 10 months) is the engine's explicit assumption, not an official figure. The work must be directly related to your major, endorsed by the DSO on Form I-20 and reviewed by USCIS.

Anyone who has left Germany on graduation and whose prior permit has lapsed cannot use this conversion route.
